name: zeffect_handle_sound_event
description: zEffect::HandleSoundEvent resolves sound refs, toggles sound active/attached state, and applies direct or parent-relative positions.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this event handler; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect event-handler/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x458f70 validates sound-ref creation, gwNodeSetActive dispatch, AddSound/RemoveSound attachment transitions, direct-position field handling, parent-world-position offset handling, and return value 2.
The native smoke verifies attach/remove behavior, active flag changes, runtime sound position and dirty flags, isAttached transitions, world list effects, and parent-relative offset positioning.
